Executive Summary
Adobe Firefly has the best product. Competitors have the better pages.
Midjourney ranks #1 for "AI art generator" (900K/mo) despite active IP lawsuits. cleanup.pictures ranks #1 for "remove object" (450K/mo) with a one-page free tool. The pattern is consistent across all 19 SEO KPI keywords: competitors with inferior products outrank Firefly because they offer frictionless, query-matched, no-login entry. Adobe's gap is not product — it is page architecture.
GAP 1 — HIGHEST IMPACT
Login gate before any generation
Ideogram, Canva, and cleanup.pictures all start without login. Firefly gates everything — driving high bounce rate, low dwell time, and suppressed rankings across every tool keyword.
Fix: allow first 5 generations without account. Gate on download only.
GAP 2 — HIGHEST VOLUME
No query-matched H1 or landing pages
"AI art generator" = 900K/mo. "AI photo editor" = 800K/mo. "Remove object" = 450K/mo. Adobe has no dedicated page for any of these — single-purpose micro-sites beat a world-class product suite.
Fix: 7 dedicated free-tool pages with H1 matching query exactly.
GAP 3 — ZERO COMPETITION
No "commercially safe" messaging above fold
Midjourney faces active lawsuits from Disney & NBC. Firefly is the only platform with IP indemnification — but this claim appears nowhere above fold. The ~87K/mo commercial safety cluster has zero competition and Adobe ignores it.
Fix: "Commercially safe · IP indemnified · CC integrated" under H1. CMS only — 2 hours.
GAP 4 — VIRAL LOOP MISSING
No attribution badge on free-tier exports
Canva's "Made with Canva" badge is their #1 viral growth driver. Every shared Canva image is a passive ad. Firefly exports are silent — zero inbound from millions of generated images.
Fix: opt-out "Created with Adobe Firefly" badge on free exports linking to firefly.adobe.com/try.

⚠ 9 GAPS
1
FRICTION → Sign-in required before any generation. Ideogram (10/day free, no account), Canva, and Midjourney trials all start without login. This single gate is the #1 reason Firefly bounces and ranks below competitors.
2
CHANGE → H1 does not match any high-volume query. "AI art generator" = 900K/mo. "AI image generator" = 1.2M/mo. Change H1 to: "AI Art Generator — Create Stunning Images Free" to capture highest-volume organic queries.
3
CHANGE → No "commercially safe" or "IP indemnified" messaging above fold. This is Firefly's uncontested moat — no competitor can claim it. Add: "Commercially safe · IP indemnified · CC integrated" as subtext under H1. Zero competition for this message.
4
CHANGE → Primary CTA must say "Try free — no account needed". Current CTA routes to sign-in. Canva CTA: "Create for free". Ideogram CTA: "Start generating". Gate only on download, not on generation.
5
ADD → Trust strip below hero: "Commercially safe · Used by 10M+ creators · IP indemnification included · 5 free generations — no account". Matches highest-intent commercial buyer queries that have zero competition.
6
ADD → Feature grid immediately below hero: tiles for "AI Image Generator", "Remove Object", "Expand Image", "AI Video Generator", "Text to Vector", "Background Generator". Each tile links to a dedicated landing page. iLovePDF and Canva win SEO because users see all tools instantly — no scrolling required.
7
ADD → Nav item "Free Tools" linking to /products/firefly with no-login tools. Adobe buries free tools. Competitors (Canva, iLovePDF) make free tools the first nav item. Users searching "AI image generator free no sign up" (180K/mo) need to land directly on a no-login page.
8
CHANGE → No competitor comparison anywhere on page. Midjourney has active IP lawsuits (Disney, NBC) — enterprise buyers are actively looking for a safe alternative. Add a comparison section: "Firefly vs Midjourney vs DALL-E — IP safety, CC integration, Custom Models". This page is the acquisition entry point for 110K/mo "midjourney alternative" searches.
9
ADD → FAQ schema section at page bottom. Q: "Is Firefly commercially safe?" Q: "Does Firefly require an account?" Q: "What AI image generator works in Photoshop?" — 3 FAQ items = AI Overview citations within 3 weeks. Fastest path to GEO presence.
Section 3 — Action Plan · Prioritised by Impact
4 Priorities to Become #1
Ordered by ranking impact. P0 and P1 alone recover the majority of the gap. P0 requires one product decision; the rest are content and CMS.
P0 — Highest Impact
Remove Login Gate — Allow First 5 Generations Without Account
Gate on download or 6th generation — not entry. All major competitors (Ideogram, Canva, cleanup.pictures) let users start immediately. This single change improves dwell time, lowers bounce rate, and re-scores every Firefly page in Google.
Metrics: Dwell time +40% · Bounce rate −25% · "AI art generator": Not ranking → Top 5
HIGH ENG · 3–4 weeks · Owner: Firefly Web PM + Eng
P0 — Highest Volume
Create 7 Dedicated Free-Tool Landing Pages
One page per P0 keyword, H1 matching query exactly, free demo above fold, no login, FAQ schema. Target URLs:

• /firefly/ai-photo-editor — 800K/mo
• /firefly/ai-video-generator — 600K/mo
• /firefly/remove-object — 450K/mo
• /firefly/upscale-image — 400K/mo

• /firefly/expand-image — 180K/mo
Metrics: Search Console impressions in 30 days · Rankings in 60 days
LOW ENG · 1–2 weeks per page · Owner: SEO + Content
